create.name: Vedanta Society of Southern California
create.bio:
The Vedanta Society of Southern California is a branch of the Ramakrishna Order of India, the monastic movement that follows Sri Ramakrishna, Sri Sarada Devi and Swami Vivekananda. Swami Prabhavananda came to Hollywood in 1929 to begin the work, on land given by a family who had hosted Vivekananda on his visit to Los Angeles three decades earlier, and the small white temple with its three domes was dedicated in 1938. Writers such as Aldous Huxley, Gerald Heard and Christopher Isherwood were drawn to it in the 1940s. Swami Swahananda led it from 1976 to 2012, and Swami Sarvadevananda is its minister today.

From its Hollywood headquarters, where the temple stands beside a monastery, a convent, a library and a bookshop, the society runs branch centres in San Diego, Santa Barbara, Trabuco Canyon and South Pasadena, and a retreat house at Piñon Hills. Monks and nuns lead free weekly classes on the Bhagavad Gita, the Upanishads and the Gospel of Sri Ramakrishna, alongside daily meditation and worship, Sunday talks, festivals and day retreats. Many classes are streamed live, and recorded talks are kept online as video and audio. Students can also stay at a monastery for up to six weeks of study and practice.

courses.title: Student Program
courses.description: A stay of up to six weeks at one of the society's monasteries, sharing the monks' daily routine while studying Vedanta, scripture, comparative religion or Sanskrit. Room and board and library use are provided, with meditation guidance on request.

courses.title: Antaryoga Retreats at Piñon Hills
courses.description: Day retreats on chosen Saturdays at the society's retreat house in the high desert, led by Pravrajika Dayaprana. Scripture is read aloud and reflected on, with group chanting, silence and a shared meal. Registration is by email.

free_resources.title: Weekly Scripture Classes
free_resources.description: Free, drop-in classes led by monks and nuns on the Bhagavad Gita, the Upanishads, the Gospel of Sri Ramakrishna and Vivekananda's writings, with time for questions. They meet in Hollywood, San Diego and Trabuco Canyon each week and in Santa Barbara monthly, and several are streamed.

free_resources.title: Video Talks
free_resources.description: Playlists of recorded Sunday talks, weekly classes and guest lectures from the Hollywood, Santa Barbara and Trabuco Canyon centres, free to watch.

free_resources.title: Audio Talks
free_resources.description: An archive of recorded talks by the society's ministers, resident monks and nuns, and visiting swamis, arranged by speaker.
